4. ACADEMICINFORMATION
AcademicCalendar
Winter semester: from 1 st October 2026 to 16 th February
2027 (examination session included).
Spring semester: from 24 th February 2027 to 4 th July 2027
(examination session included).
Nominationdeadline
Wintersemester/Fullyear: 31st May
Summersemester: 30th November

ApplicationProcedure
 The application will only be considered through
nomination by the Home University;
 application system for incoming students
https://usosirk.amu.edu.pl;
 Applicationdeadline:
o first semester (winter) and/or full academic
year: from April 1st to June 30th;
o second semester (spring): from October
15th to December 15th.
Coursesinformation amupie.amu.edu.pl
Gradingsystem
A/5 EXCELLENT - outstanding performance
B/4+ VERY GOOD - above the average standard with only
minor errors
C/4 GOOD - generally sound work with some minor
errors
D/3+ SATISFACTORY - fair but with a number of notable
errors
E/3 SUFFICIENT - fair but with significant shortcomings
F/2 FAIL
A Transcript of Records will be issued by the receiving
institution no later than 5 weeks after the assessment period
has finished at the receiving HEI.
5. ADDITIONALINFORMATION
Accommodation
You will be asked if you would like to stay at one of our
dormitories during your application procedure. When the
application process is complete, we will let you know if you
can get a place in the dormitory or not. We cannot provide
accommodation for every student who applies for Erasmus+
at AMU.
